findings.title: UploadFile.save on a released upload truncates the destination before throwing
findings.description: save() opens new FileOutputStream(destination), which truncates it, before transferTo -> inputStream() -> checkContent() throws IllegalStateException. A second save(dest), or save after close or after the request ended, wipes the file the first save just wrote to 0 bytes and then throws. Data loss on a common misuse. DefaultUploadFileTest.assertContentGone saves into an empty temp file, so the truncation is never observed.
findings.suggested_fix: Call checkContent() under the lock (or open the input stream) before opening the FileOutputStream. Extend assertContentGone to pre-fill the destination and assert its bytes survive.

findings.title: 405 Allow: GET, HEAD (and the directory 301) is decided without the symlink/containment checks GET applies
findings.description: wouldServeGet() uses only StaticPath.check plus File.isFile()/isDirectory(), which follow symbolic links. For a symlink below the root (refused by default, or pointing outside the root) POST/PUT/OPTIONS get 405 Allow: GET, HEAD while GET gets 404. That violates FR-STATIC-002 AC-5 (405 only when a GET would be answered from the file system) and reveals that refused links and their targets exist. serveFrom (156-163) uses the same link-following isDirectory() and answers a refused symlinked directory with 301.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide through the resolver: for files apply the resolver check (canonical containment, plus linkFree unless allowSymlinks); for directories apply listable() or the same check before answering 405 or 301. Add POST /outlink.txt and POST /inlink.txt -> 404 cases to StaticMethodTest.

findings.title: TinyHttpd sendFile commits before opening the file
findings.description: ex.commit(status, headers, length) runs before new RandomAccessFile(file, "r"). A missing file (length() returns 0, so offset 0 / length 0 passes the IAE guard in TinyHttpdExchange.sendFile 211-220) or an unreadable one throws FileNotFoundException after the head is committed. The result is a started response with a declared Content-Length and no body, instead of an unstarted response the caller can still answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Open the RandomAccessFile and seek first, then commit inside the try-with-resources. Add a socket test with an unreadable or missing file asserting the response is still unstarted (the Http.ok pattern of badOffsetOrLengthIsRefusedBeforeTheResponseStarts).

findings.title: Mount options are not frozen: the configurer's StaticOptions stays live after listen
findings.description: DefaultRestApp.addStatic hands the DefaultStaticOptions instance to the Configurer, and StaticMount.freeze() keeps that same mutable object (ArrayList spaExcludes and cachePatterns, LinkedHashMap mimes, plain non-volatile fields). A configurer that keeps the reference can mutate it after listen() while worker threads iterate it (ConcurrentModificationException, unsafe publication), bypassing the NEW-state guard that every other setter enforces (FR-APP-002).
findings.suggested_fix: In freeze() take an immutable snapshot (copied lists and maps, final fields), or make DefaultStaticOptions setters refuse after freeze. Precompile the cache patterns in the same snapshot.

findings.title: Each static hit canonicalizes and link-walks the path about five times
findings.description: FileResponder.respond calls r.length, r.etag, r.modified and r.open. Each one runs check(): getCanonicalPath, linkFree (one getCanonicalPath per component) and isFile, and open() runs it twice. For depth d that is about 5*(d+2) realpath syscalls per request (Android has no canonical cache, and the tests turn the JVM cache off). The separate stats also let length, ETag and Last-Modified describe different versions of a file that changes during the request.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve once into a small snapshot (canonical File, length, lastModified) used for the validators, then open with one post-open re-check. Keep the ResourceResolver SPI and add an internal fast path if needed.

findings.title: Backslash in a decoded segment is not refused (Windows JVM)
findings.description: check() refuses decoded segments holding '/' or NUL but not a backslash. On a Windows JVM (a supported Java 8+ target) /a%5C..%5C.env decodes to one segment a\..\.env. It does not start with '.', so it passes the dot rules, and java.io.File resolves it to root\.env. Containment still holds and linkFree rejects it by default, but with allowSymlinks(true) the hidden-path 404 of FR-STATIC-005 AC-2 is bypassed.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat a decoded backslash like '/' and answer 400. Add the case to StaticTraversalTest.

findings.title: FR-STATIC-011 AC-5 (observing resolver calls for static, res.file and res.download) has no test
findings.description: AC-5 requires a test that observes open, length, etag and modified on the built-in resolver for each of static mounts, res.file and res.download. No test in NaruServe-api, NaruServe-tinyhttpd or src/test cites FR-STATIC-011 AC-5; FileResponseTest covers only AC-1, AC-2 and AC-4.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test that spies on FileResourceResolver (through a package-private factory, or the reflection path StaticSymlinkTest already uses) and asserts the four calls for all three entry points.

findings.title: Cache patterns are compiled to regex on every static request
findings.description: select() calls compile(pattern) for every registered pattern on every file response (the code marks this as a shortcut). Patterns are fixed at listen, so this is per-request garbage and regex compilation on the hot path, Android included.
findings.suggested_fix: Precompile in StaticMount.freeze() together with the options snapshot, then drop the shortcut comment.

findings.title: Per-request regex and SimpleDateFormat churn in date handling; HEAD opens the file
findings.description: parseDate runs String.replaceAll("\\s+", " "), which compiles a Pattern on each call, and builds up to three SimpleDateFormat instances per header; format() builds another one per response. respond() also opens a FileInputStream for HEAD, only for the bodyless path to close it again.
findings.suggested_fix: Hold a static precompiled Pattern, use a ThreadLocal<SimpleDateFormat> or a hand-written IMF-fixdate formatter, and skip r.open for HEAD.

findings.title: Production resolver carries a test hook reachable only by reflection
findings.description: afterCheck is a volatile field read on every open() and reached only through setAccessible reflection from StaticSymlinkTest (app.dispatcher().statics.mounts[0].resolver()). That couples the test to private field names, and production code pays a volatile read on every request.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject the hook through a package-private constructor or factory that the tests use, or move the test into the internal package and call it without reflection.

findings.title: Dead helpers added in this window
findings.description: DefaultMimeTypes.registered(String) and DefaultStaticOptions.mime(String) (DefaultStaticOptions.java:104-107) have no caller in main or test code; lookup() reads the maps directly.

findings.title: Options accept degenerate values: index(".."), MIME types holding CR/LF
findings.description: index() rejects only empty names and '/'. It accepts '..', '.', '.hidden' and backslashes; containment stops '..' at runtime, but the mount then silently serves nothing. DefaultMimeTypes.type() checks only non-empty, so a type with CR/LF is accepted at registration and fails only per request when res.header refuses it.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate at registration: the index must not be '.' or '..' or contain a backslash, and the MIME type must be a valid field value (reuse the header field-value check).

findings.title: CachePolicy.immutable() can be appended to no-store and no-cache
findings.description: noStore().immutable() renders "no-store, immutable" and noCache().immutable() renders "no-cache, immutable". These directives contradict each other: RFC 8246 immutable applies only to fresh responses.
findings.suggested_fix: Document it, or ignore immutable() on no-store and no-cache. IR-STATIC-002 does not require either, so a docs-only fix is acceptable.

findings.title: Directory listing is unbounded
findings.description: render() lists, sorts and canonicalizes every entry into one in-memory String. A directory with very many entries makes each GET /dir/ cost O(n) canonical syscalls and an unbounded heap allocation (the feature is opt-in).
findings.suggested_fix: Cap the number of entries and say so in docs/api/static.md, or stream the HTML.

findings.title: The 64 MiB heap test relies on System.gc() and client-side timing
findings.description: usedHeap() calls System.gc(), which is only advisory, and measures the heap of the same JVM that runs the client read loop. The test can be flaky on loaded CI, and it does not check the fixed-size-buffer clause of FR-STATIC-003 AC-4.
findings.suggested_fix: Retry the measurement a few times or read MemoryMXBean after gc, and add a class-text check for the 8192-byte buffer like hookUsesNoZeroCopyTransfer.
